title: adenostyles alliariae subsp. pyrenaica
intro: Adenostyles alliariae subsp. pyrenaica, commonly known as the Pyrenean false oxtongue, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion tribe within the sunflower family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of Adenostyles alliariae subsp. pyrenaica include its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, as well as other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
